141	    *,
142	    message: str,
143	    history: list,
144	    session_context: dict[str, str],
145	    available_days: float | None,
146	    context_selection: list[dict] | None,
147	    provider,
148	    session_id_str: str | None,
149	    db: AsyncSession,
150	    active_config: dict,
151	) -> ChatResponse:
152	    """Normal chat turn: mask → LLM → reply or pending_action.
153	
154	    If the LLM calls an internal action (registered in _INTERNAL_ACTIONS), it is
155	    auto-executed without consultant confirmation and the result is fed back to the
156	    LLM for a natural-language response. External tool calls return pending_action.
157	    """
158	    tools = workflow_registry.get_tool_definitions()
159	
160	    # Masking pipeline — register identifiable fields BEFORE mask_text (FR17, ARC-9).
161	    token_map = TokenMap()
162	    if session_context:
163	        mask_fields({k: v for k, v in session_context.items() if v}, token_map)
164	
165	    masked_message = mask_text(message, token_map)
166	
167	    # Derive effective_available_days: explicit scalar takes precedence;
168	    # fall back to count of selected rows when only context_selection is provided.
169	    effective_available_days: float | None
170	    if available_days is not None:
171	        effective_available_days = available_days
172	    elif context_selection:
173	        effective_available_days = float(len(context_selection))
174	    else:
175	        effective_available_days = None
176	
177	    # Build messages: system → masked history → optional context → new masked user turn.
178	    # History masking resolves the Story 3.3 deferred item.
179	    agent_instructions = active_config.get("agent_instructions", "")
180	    messages: list[dict] = []
181	    if agent_instructions:
182	        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": agent_instructions})
183	    for turn in history:
184	        messages.append(
185	            {"role": turn.role, "content": mask_text(turn.content, token_map)}
186	        )
187	    if context_selection:
188	        messages.append(
189	            {
190	                "role": "user",
191	                "content": f"[Selected context]: {json.dumps(context_selection, default=str)}",
192	            }
193	        )
194	    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": masked_message})
195	
196	    start_ms = int(time.monotonic() * 1000)
197	    try:
198	        llm_response = await provider.complete(messages, tools)
199	    except ProviderError as exc:
200	        logger.warning("chat_llm_error", extra={"error": str(exc)})
201	        raise
202	    latency_ms = int(time.monotonic() * 1000) - start_ms
203	
204	    masked_output = llm_response.content or ""
205	    tool_calls_json = (
206	        json.dumps(llm_response.tool_calls) if llm_response.tool_calls else None
207	    )
208	
209	    await _write_log(
210	        db=db,
211	        session_id_str=session_id_str,
212	        masked_input=masked_message,
213	        masked_output=masked_output,
214	        tool_calls=tool_calls_json,
215	        latency_ms=latency_ms,
216	    )
217	
218	    # Tool call path: internal actions auto-execute; external tools return pending_action.
219	    if llm_response.finish_reason == "tool_calls" and llm_response.tool_calls:
220	        tool_call = llm_response.tool_calls[0]  # first tool call only in v1
221	        tool_name = tool_call.get("name", "")
222	        params = tool_call.get("arguments", {})
223	
224	        if _find_tool_definition(tool_name) is None:
225	            logger.warning("chat_unknown_tool_name", extra={"tool": tool_name})
226	            reply = (
227	                rehydrate_text(masked_output, token_map)
228	                if masked_output
229	                else "I encountered an unexpected error. Please try again."
230	            )
231	            return ChatResponse(
232	                data=ChatData(reply=reply),
233	                meta=Meta(request_id=str(uuid.uuid4())),
234	            )
235	
236	        # Check if this is an internal action (auto-execute, no confirmation needed).
237	        _, resolved_action = _resolve_integration(tool_name)
238	        internal_fn = _INTERNAL_ACTIONS.get(resolved_action or tool_name)

252	            logger.info(
253	                "tool_call_complete",
254	                extra={
255	                    "session_id": session_id_str or "unknown",
256	                    "tool": resolved_action or tool_name,

258	                    "masked_input": json.dumps(

260	                    ),
261	                },
262	            )
263	
264	            # Feed result back to LLM for natural-language response.
265	            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": masked_output or ""})

267	                {
268	                    "role": "user",
269	                    "content": f"[Tool result for {tool_name}]: {json.dumps(result, default=str)}",

311	async def _handle_confirm(
312	    *,
313	    confirm: ConfirmPayload,
314	    history: list,
315	    session_context: dict[str, str],
316	    provider,
317	    session_id_str: str | None,
318	    db: AsyncSession,
319	    active_config: dict,
320	) -> ChatResponse:
321	    """
322	    Confirmed tool execution path (FR6, FR16).
323	
324	    1. Resolve integration from registry by tool name.
325	    2. Execute via IntegrationBase.execute() — raises IntegrationError on failure (FR16).
326	    3. Feed tool result back to LLM for natural-language confirmation reply.
327	    4. Return rehydrated final reply.
328	    """
329	    # Rebuild token_map from session_context for masking params and rehydrating reply.
330	    token_map = TokenMap()
331	    if session_context:
332	        mask_fields({k: v for k, v in session_context.items() if v}, token_map)
333	
334	    # Resolve integration — registry-driven, no if/else.
335	    integration_name, resolved_action = _resolve_integration(confirm.tool_name)
336	    integration = _INTEGRATION_REGISTRY.get(integration_name)
337	    if integration is None:
338	        raise HTTPException(
339	            status_code=503,
340	            detail=f"No integration registered for tool '{confirm.tool_name}'",
341	        )
342	
343	    # Rehydrate masked tokens in params before passing to integration (FR18).
344	    rehydrated_params = json.loads(
345	        rehydrate_text(json.dumps(confirm.params), token_map)
346	    )
347	
348	    # Execute tool — IntegrationError propagates to global handler → 503 (FR16).
349	    start_ms = int(time.monotonic() * 1000)
350	    tool_result = await integration.execute(
351	        resolved_action if resolved_action is not None else confirm.action,
352	        rehydrated_params,
353	    )
354	    latency_ms = int(time.monotonic() * 1000) - start_ms
355	
356	    logger.info(
357	        "tool_call_complete",
358	        extra={
359	            "session_id": session_id_str or "unknown",
360	            "tool": integration_name,
361	            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
362	            "masked_input": mask_text(
363	                json.dumps(confirm.params, default=str), token_map
364	            ),
365	        },
366	    )
367	
368	    # Feed tool result back to LLM for a natural-language confirmation message.
369	    tools = workflow_registry.get_tool_definitions()
370	    agent_instructions = active_config.get("agent_instructions", "")
371	    messages: list[dict] = []
372	    if agent_instructions:
373	        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": agent_instructions})
374	    for turn in history:
375	        messages.append(
376	            {"role": turn.role, "content": mask_text(turn.content, token_map)}
377	        )
378	    tool_result_json = json.dumps(tool_result, default=str)
379	    masked_tool_result = mask_text(tool_result_json, token_map)
380	    messages.append(
381	        {
382	            "role": "user",
383	            "content": f"[Tool result for {confirm.tool_name}]: {masked_tool_result}",
384	        }
385	    )
386	
387	    llm_start_ms = int(time.monotonic() * 1000)
388	    masked_output = ""
389	    try:
390	        llm_response = await provider.complete(messages, tools)
391	        masked_output = llm_response.content or ""
392	    except ProviderError as exc:
393	        logger.warning("chat_llm_post_tool_error", extra={"error": str(exc)})
394	        raise
395	    finally:
396	        llm_latency_ms = int(time.monotonic() * 1000) - llm_start_ms
397	        await _write_log(
398	            db=db,
399	            session_id_str=session_id_str,
400	            masked_input=mask_text(json.dumps(confirm.params, default=str), token_map),
401	            masked_output=masked_output,
402	            tool_calls=None,
403	            latency_ms=llm_latency_ms,
404	        )
405	
406	    reply = rehydrate_text(masked_output, token_map)
407	
408	    return ChatResponse(
409	        data=ChatData(reply=reply),
410	        meta=Meta(request_id=str(uuid.uuid4())),

414	def _build_pending_action(tool_call: dict) -> ToolCallProposal:
415	    """
416	    Build a ToolCallProposal from a normalized LLM tool call.
417	
418	    Normalized format (from both providers):
419	        {"id": "...", "name": "tool_name", "arguments": {...}}
420	    """
421	    tool_name = tool_call.get("name", "")
422	    params = tool_call.get("arguments", {})
423	
424	    tool_def = _find_tool_definition(tool_name)
425	    description = tool_def.get("description", tool_name) if tool_def else tool_name
426	
427	    _, resolved_action = _resolve_integration(tool_name)
428	    resolved_action = resolved_action or tool_name
429	
430	    display_text = description
431	    if params:
432	        param_summary = ", ".join(f"{k}={v!r}" for k, v in list(params.items())[:3])
433	        display_text = f"{description} ({param_summary})"
434	
435	    return ToolCallProposal(
436	        tool_name=tool_name,
437	        action=resolved_action,
438	        params=params,
439	        display_text=display_text,
440	    )

443	def _find_tool_definition(tool_name: str) -> dict | None:
444	    """Look up a tool definition dict from the active workflow config by name."""
445	    active = workflow_registry.active_config
446	    if active is None:
447	        return None
448	    for tool in active.get("tools", []):
449	        if tool.get("name") == tool_name:
450	            return tool
451	    return None

454	def _resolve_integration(tool_name: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
455	    """
456	    Return (integration_name, action) for a tool name.
457	
458	    Reads integration and action from workflow config's ToolDefinition.
459	    Falls back to tool_name for both if not specified.
460	    """
461	    tool_def = _find_tool_definition(tool_name)
462	    if tool_def is None:
463	        return tool_name, None
464	    integration_name = tool_def.get("integration") or tool_name
465	    action = tool_def.get("action")
466	    return integration_name, action
